limitations: Small ordered native OMat24 sample; internal parent-disjoint holdout, not official test data.
Periodic geometry/species model has no explicit magnetic-state conditioning; stress is not trained or evaluated.
Large source force outliers are retained; the train/holdout force scales differ substantially.
Fixed full-batch epochs do not establish convergence; no holdout checkpoint or setting selection.
Three model seeds on fixed selections do not measure random-selection or dataset-split variance.
Complete coarsened-class/presence coverage does not preserve every detailed token or guarantee accuracy.
